title: StatePort — pick up where you left off

slides.title: Pick up your work where you left off
slides.body: StatePort keeps your study plan or project on your computer, with your progress and a record of changes.
slides.note: For students and project owners. Screenshots are the separate local StudyState Sample captured on 5 September 2026.

slides.title: Review before you start
slides.body: Your study activity is not started. Choose Start, inspect the proposed change, then approve it to mark the activity in progress.
slides.note: Verified built-in sample behavior. This is not evidence of general AI execution or imported-template Runs.

slides.title: Save what you learned
slides.body: Write a reflection, review its effect, and save it. Open the receipt: it records the change that was applied.
slides.note: A reflection is self-reported learning, not independently verified learning. A receipt does not establish correctness or reversibility.

slides.title: Return to saved progress
slides.body: After a local service restart, the activity and reflection were still there. You can see where the study session left off.
slides.note: Phone-sized browser view only. No cross-device synchronization or machine reboot claim.

slides.title: Start with the study example
slides.body: Watch the 86-second field guide or read its transcript. Fresh public installation is blocked; wait for a corrected, qualified release.
slides.note: Status as of 5 September 2026: Alpha.16 predecessor signature lookup and private image registry prevent fresh installation. Native Windows 11 WSL2 qualification and human acceptance remain pending.
